text:
Situation: Penicillin G potassium has been on FDA's shortage list since 2023-04-26 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 11.6 days of injection and 24.3 days of powder. Corvale General holds 15.4 days of injection and 20.6 days of powder.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2023-04-26. The registered plant on our label is Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189). FDA inspection 1208260 at that plant ended 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI, 51 days after the posting. The VAI classification letter is dated 2024-09-10, 503 days after the posting. No FDA action at a registered plant is recorded before the 2023-04-26 posting.

Our position: Current inventory covers roughly two to three weeks. No alternative supplier is on FDA's shortage list today. The five ranked options all lack identifiable plants on their labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place initial orders with Athenex Pharmaceutical Division, LLC (ranked first) and confirm delivery dates; P&T Committee to approve addition to formulary.
2. Buyer to qualify Avenacy Inc., Chartwell RX, LLC, Laboratorios Atral, S.A., and NorthStar Rx, LLC as backup sources; P&T Committee to approve each if needed.
3. Buyer to monitor daily usage and update days-on-hand for both campuses; Pharmacy Director to approve any allocation changes.

Not recommended: Switching to alternative agents or changing dosing regimens; those are clinical decisions for the treating clinicians and the committee.
